excerpt.zh:
我们可以修饰住在我们帝国的任何开智种族，如果他们有足够的特质点数的话。

通过物种界面的修饰菜单，然后研究特殊项目。这个项目需要£society£社会学研究，并且在执行项目时会暂停正在进行的社会学研究。
excerpt.en:
We can Modify any sapient species living within our empire, provided they have enough Trait Points.

This can be achieved by accessing the Modify menu from the Species screen, and then researching the appropriate Special Project. The project requires £society£

texts.en:
We can Modify any sapient species living within our empire, provided they have enough Trait Points.

This can be achieved by accessing the Modify menu from the Species screen, and then researching the appropriate Special Project. The project requires £society£ Society research and will divert all our technological progress in that field while it is active.
